items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Everybody – Bird used to sleep in that place a lot.

ctx.x: You and Bird must have talked about some of the things that you were thinking about and writing about. Of course he was perhaps the master of the flatted fifth, and here you are, thinking about your . . .
Everybody – Bird used to sleep in that place a lot.
You’re thinking about the raised fourth, and he’s the flatted fifth master.
